pkgmetadata.longdescription: Everdo is a to-do list and task manager built around the Getting Things Done (GTD) method: inbox, next actions, projects, areas, contexts and weekly review, with optional end-to-end encrypted or local-network sync. Repackaged from the upstream Debian binary package; it bundles its own Electron runtime.

use.flag: Install the bundled chrome-sandbox helper setuid root. Only needed on kernels without CONFIG_USER_NS, or where unprivileged user namespaces are blocked by a sysctl or an LSM. Otherwise leave this off: the bundled Chromium uses its namespace sandbox, which needs no elevated privileges at all.
